$comment: Bass directory: the coverage map for the patch library. status: native = the engine can make it today; needs-addition = waits for a phase-3 engine addition; approximation = depends on recorded instruments or processes a synth cannot do, built as a clearly labelled synth version. Entries about how a bass is played are built for their sound only.

families.description: Clean sine/triangle weight, felt more than heard.
Pitch-dropped, decaying sine kicks-as-bass, from clean to blown out.
Warm subtractive analog basses: Moog, Taurus, octave disco, chunky squares.
Resonant, squelchy single-oscillator lines with accent and slide.
Elastic, vocal, envelope-driven basses: rubber, auto-wah, talkbox.
Detuned, phase-cancelling saw stacks with slow movement.
PWM-saw rave basses with heavy ensemble chorus.
Tight, gated, chorused vintage polysynth basses: outrun, darkwave.
Percussive FM basses: metallic plunks, slaps, log drums, donks.
Short, fast-decay plucks that leave space.
Tempo-synced filter or wavetable wobbles over a solid sub.
Formant, comb and multiband-distorted talking basses.
Overdriven, fuzzed, aggressive basses: industrial, metal, phonk.
Huge, slow, dark or unstable film and ambient basses.
West-coast, physical-model, glitch and illusion basses.
LORN-style terror basses: dark, saturated, tape-worn and wide above a clean sub, always alive with slow, non-repeating movement, sitting in a dark space.

entries.name: Moog bass
entries.identity: Warm, thick detuned saw/square through a self-oscillating 24 dB low-pass.

entries.name: 303 acid bass
entries.identity: Squelchy resonant saw/square through an 18 dB diode ladder, driven by slide, accent and fast envelopes.

entries.name: Reese bass
entries.identity: Two slightly detuned saws phase-cancelling into a wide, gritty, moving low end.

entries.name: Hoover / Alpha Juno bass
entries.identity: Dense rave PWM-saw with intense analog ensemble chorus.

entries.name: Synthwave / Outrun bass
entries.identity: Tightly compressed, snappy vintage saw bass (Juno / Prophet style).

entries.name: Goth / darkwave gated bass
entries.identity: Cold, rigid analog bass drenched in chorus and high-ratio compression.

entries.name: Disco octave / Moroder bass
entries.identity: Punchy square/pulse bass made for octave-jumping lines (sound only; pattern is the player's).

entries.name: Taurus pedal bass
entries.identity: Ultra-deep, room-shaking analog bass with massive sustain and low-mid presence.

entries.name: FM LatelyBass / Solid bass
entries.identity: Punchy 4-operator FM bass with a sharp, metallic, aggressive transient plunk.

entries.name: Eurodance M1 bass
entries.identity: 90s digital bass: artificial plastic attack click over a rubbery, hollow body.

entries.name: DX7 digital slap
entries.identity: Hyper-percussive, glassy FM slap simulating a snapped string.

entries.name: Amapiano log drum
entries.identity: Hollow, resonant FM/wavetable thud like a struck wooden log drum.

entries.name: Slap / pluck FM bass
entries.identity: Bright metallic FM bass with a high modulator index on the initial snap.

entries.name: Organ bass
entries.identity: Digital organ filtered down to its sub and lower-mid harmonics.

entries.name: Nu-disco rubber bass
entries.identity: Bouncy, elastic "oww-waw" bass from a tight envelope on the filter cutoff.

entries.name: 2000s R&B pluck
entries.identity: Ultra-clean sine/triangle pluck with lightning-fast decay and no sustain.

entries.name: Donk bass
entries.identity: Percussive, metallic, pitch-modulated clack like a struck plastic pipe.

entries.name: Wobble bass
entries.identity: Sub-heavy bass with a tempo-synced LFO on filter cutoff or wavetable position.

entries.name: Growl / yoi bass
entries.identity: Wavetable through formant/vowel/comb filtering: an aggressive talking throat.

entries.name: Neuro bass
entries.identity: Constantly morphing, multiband-distorted, phased bass.
entries.approximation_note: True resampling loops are approximated with multiband distortion and complex modulation.

entries.name: Cyberpunk mid-tempo bass
entries.identity: Crushing square through moving notch/band-pass filters: grinding mechanical gears.

entries.name: Drift phonk cow-bass
entries.identity: Blown-out, low, detuned square with aggressive pitch glides (the cowbell itself is a separate drum).

entries.name: Rage / hyperpop blown-out 808
entries.identity: Sub kick pushed far past clipping into square-wave fuzz.

entries.name: Hardstyle reverse bass
entries.identity: Distorted kick transient followed by a reversed, rising sub swell.

entries.name: Industrial / EBM driven bass
entries.identity: Harsh, overdriven square/saw for machinelike repetition.

entries.name: Industrial rock (NIN) bass
entries.identity: Toxic analog clipping, fuzz and white noise that tears through guitar walls.

entries.name: Synth-metal doom bass
entries.identity: Ultra-low fuzzed square/saw hybrid like a 5-string down-tuned to drop G.

entries.name: Pure sub bass
entries.identity: Clean, unmodulated sine or filtered triangle below 60 Hz, felt rather than heard.

entries.name: Reggaeton dembow sub
entries.identity: Round, compressed, slightly saturated sub with deep warm weight.

entries.name: Baile funk sub-pluck
entries.identity: Raw sub with a sharp downbeat pluck and a lo-fi mid-range knock.

entries.name: King Tubby / dub rubber bass
entries.identity: Extremely low-passed bass, all highs gone: a physical sound-system thud.

entries.name: Offbeat / psy-trance bass
entries.identity: Short, hyper-compressed saw pluck shaped to sit between kicks (sound only).

entries.name: Sine-drop / 808
entries.identity: Kick-like sine with a long, decaying, pitch-bent sub tail.

entries.name: West Coast G-funk low
entries.identity: Deep smooth sub-triangle under a singing, whining high sine layer.

entries.name: Indie-pop chunky square
entries.identity: Clean, mid-heavy, slightly overdriven square with clockwork precision.

entries.name: Zimmer braam
entries.identity: Colossal brass-and-saw hybrid with multiband saturation.
entries.approximation_note: Real tubas/cimbassi are approximated with detuned saws, formant brass filtering and saturation.

entries.name: LORN broken tape flutter
entries.identity: Heavy analog bass with rapid random pitch drift: decayed, haunted, defective.

entries.name: LORN infra-bass rumble
entries.identity: Ghostly sub sine at 20-30 Hz relying on saturation and air pressure.

entries.name: Clockwork / tick-tock bass
entries.identity: Short, tight pluck with a ticking transient for cinematic tension.
entries.approximation_note: Real clocks and spiccato strings are approximated with a synthesized tick transient.

entries.name: Organic hybrid sub
entries.identity: Stretched, pitched acoustic string layered with a pure sub sine.
entries.approximation_note: Recorded double-bass/cello is approximated with the physical-model string.

entries.name: Drone / brass bass
entries.identity: Massive, slow-opening, detuned analog horn texture.

entries.name: Shoegaze wall / drone fog
entries.identity: Endless, very wide, chorus-and-reverb-soaked low fog.

entries.name: Pop-punk sub drop
entries.identity: Single clean sine with a dramatic downward pitch sweep for impacts.

entries.name: West Coast / Buchla bass
entries.identity: Wavefolder through a low-pass gate: rich acoustic-like thumps without a classic filter.

entries.name: Physical modeling bass
entries.identity: String/tube equations: eerie, hyper-real acoustic-digital hybrids.

entries.name: Glitch / micro bass
entries.identity: Rhythmic low end made of tiny digital bursts, clicks and pops.
entries.approximation_note: Granular synthesis is approximated with gating, sample-and-hold and the bitcrusher.

entries.name: Chiptune / 8-bit bass
entries.identity: Deliberately lo-fi, unfiltered triangle or pulse like a retro sound chip.

entries.name: Shepard tone bass
entries.identity: Cross-fading octave-spaced sines: an endlessly falling or rising sub illusion.

entries.name: Generative modular drone
entries.identity: Endlessly evolving cross-modulated drone driven by random sample-and-hold.

entries.name: Envelope-filter / Bootsy bass
entries.identity: Rubbery tone through an auto-wah envelope filter: elastic funk squelch.

entries.name: Talkbox / Zapp bass
entries.identity: Vowel-shifting bass mimicking a human mouth shape.

entries.name: Laser / pitch-bent snap
entries.identity: Instant downward pitch spike on the attack: a "pew" transient.

entries.name: Reese-growl cross
entries.identity: Wide phase-cancelled Reese routed into an LFO-driven growl filter.
